def query1_recent_articles\(cursor\):

        SELECT TOP 5

            title, 
            source_name, 
            SUBSTRING\(content, 1, 500\) as content_preview,

        FROM articles
        WHERE content IS NOT NULL AND LEN\(content\) > 300

    """\)

def query2_themed_pairs\(cursor\):

    print\("\\n" + "=" * 80\)

    print\("=" * 80\)

            a1.title, 
            a1.source_name, 
            at1.theme_id, 
            t.name as theme_name, 
            LEN\(a1.content\) as content_len
        FROM article_themes at1
        JOIN articles a1 ON at1.article_id = a1.id
        JOIN themes t ON at1.theme_id = t.id
        WHERE a1.content IS NOT NULL AND LEN\(a1.content\) > 300
        AND t.article_count >= 2
        ORDER BY a1.published_date DESC
    """\)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall\(\)
    results = []

    for row in rows:
        article = {
            "article_id": row[0],
            "title": row[1],
            "source_name": row[2],
            "theme_id": row[3],
            "theme_name": row[4],
            "content_len": row[5],
        }
        results.append\(article\)

        print\(f"  Source: {article['source_name']}"\)
        print\(f"  Theme ID: {article['theme_id']} - {article['theme_name']}"\)

            for a in articles:
                print\(f"    - [{a['article_id']}] {a['title']} \({a['source_name']}\)"\)
    
    return results, themes_seen


def query3_full_content\(cursor, article_ids=None\):
    """Get full content of articles for test payloads."""
    print\("\\n" + "=" * 80\)
    print\("QUERY 3: Full content of recent articles"\)

    else:

            FROM articles a
            WHERE a.content IS NOT NULL AND LEN\(a.content\) > 300
            ORDER BY a.published_date DESC
        """\)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall\(\)
    results = []
    for row in rows:
        article = {
            "id": row[0],
            "title": row[1],
            "source_name": row[2],
            "content": row[3],
            "content_len": len\(row[3]\) if row[3] else 0,
            "published_date": str\(row[4]\) if row[4] else None,
            "category": row[5],
        }
        results.append\(article\)

        print\(f"  Title: {article['title']}"\)
        print\(f"  Source: {article['source_name']}"\)
        print\(f"  Category: {article['category']}"\)
        print\(f"  Content length: {article['content_len']} chars"\)
        print\(f"  Published: {article['published_date']}"\)
        content_preview = article['content'][:300] if article['content'] else "\(empty\)"
        print\(f"  Content \(first 300 chars\): {content_preview}..."\)

def run_query\(cursor, sql, params=None\):
    if params:
        cursor.execute\(sql, params\)
    else:
        cursor.execute\(sql\)
    cols = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
    return [dict\(zip\(cols, row\)\) for row in cursor.fetchall\(\)]

    conn = get_connection\(\)
    cursor = conn.cursor\(\)
    print\('Connected successfully!'\)

            SUBSTRING\(ca.content, 1, 500\) as content_preview,

            LEN\(ca.content\) as content_len
        FROM article_themes at1
        JOIN collected_articles ca ON at1.article_id = ca.id
        JOIN sources s ON ca.source_id = s.id
